basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Pokémon enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been trading and battling Pokémon since the original Red and Blue versions. Outside of gaming, I work as a network engineer, and enjoy tinkering with emulators in my free time. Married to my high school sweetheart, and we often game together. Typically online during late evenings and weekends due to my work schedule. I love sharing my knowledge about Pokémon and helping others complete their Pokédex.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in networking and computer systems, primarily self-taught through online resources and hands-on experience. A Pokémon expert, having played every mainline game and many spin-offs. Actively follows gaming forums and attends conventions to stay updated.
